title: Healing of Extraction Sites after Alveolar Ridge Preservation Using Advanced Platelet-Rich Fibrin: A Retrospective Study
authors: Khaddour AS, Ghiță RE, Ionescu M, Rîcă RG, Mercuț V, Manolea HO, Camen A, Drăghici EC, Radu A, Popescu SM. Bioengineering (Basel). 2024 Jun 3;11(6):566. doi: 10.3390/bioengineering11060566. * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The results obtained after ARP with A -PRF showed a reduced loss of bone volume compared to spontaneous healing” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
